gems.title: 野马九号
gems.summary: 1973年智利，性格迥异的CIA特工克里斯和李被局长从圣地亚哥派往复活节岛，这对搭档将执行一项考验彼此信任和忠诚的任务。
gems.summaryEn: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Amongst the Island's iconic statues, and as the longtime partner
gems.whyWatch: 冷战背景遇上复活节岛荒诞搭档戏，历史质感与黑色幽默兼具。
gems.whyWatchEn: A Cold War setting meets an Easter Island odd-couple crime thriller, with historical texture and dark humor.
gems.audience: 喜欢黑色幽默、历史背景与怪咖搭档的观众
gems.audienceEn: Fans of dark humor, historical settings, and odd-couple buddy stories

gems.title: 我演洛奇
gems.summary: 根据西尔维斯特·史泰龙真实经历改编。一位名不见经传的演员西尔维斯特·史泰龙坚信，自己不仅要编写《洛奇》的剧本，更要亲自出演洛奇·巴尔博亚。面对重重阻挠，他押上一切，坚持争取主角机会。
gems.summaryEn: The electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky—he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets
gems.whyWatch: 史泰龙押上一切的自我致敬，献给所有不被看好的创作者。
gems.whyWatchEn: Stallone's all-in self-tribute, a story for every underdog creator.
gems.audience: 影迷、追梦者与励志传记片爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Film buffs, dream chasers, and inspirational biopic fans

gems.title: 野兽之心
gems.summary: 一名前陆军特种部队士兵与他退役战犬在阿拉斯加深处遭遇坠机事故后，这对老搭档必须在环境严酷的极地荒野中相互扶持，为生存而战。
gems.summaryEn: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for
gems.whyWatch: 人与战犬的极地求生，把动作张力压在沉默羁绊里。
gems.whyWatchEn: A man and his retired combat dog survive the Arctic, packing action tension into silent bonding.
gems.audience: 求生冒险片与狗狗题材爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of survival adventures and dog-centered stories

gems.title: 罗摩衍那：王子传奇
gems.summary: 改编自印度古代史诗《罗摩衍那》。魔王罗波那作恶多端，欲用武力一统三界。毗湿奴神化身罗摩降临凡尘，担起守护众生的重任。十四年流放间罗摩降妖除魔，一步步激怒了罗波那。当妻子悉多被掳走，彻底点燃了罗摩心中的战意。
gems.summaryEn: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater chal
gems.whyWatch: 把印度史诗的流放、神魔与爱情拍成宏大冒险，文化奇观感突出。
gems.whyWatchEn: Turns the Indian epic's exile, divine conflict, and love into a grand adventure with striking cultural spectacle.
gems.audience: 神话史诗与异域文化爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of mythological epics and cross-cultural spectacle

gems.title: 寒夜怪谈
gems.summary: 改编自查尔斯·狄更斯小说《圣诞颂歌》。一位年迈的吝啬商人遭遇故友亡灵及圣诞过去、现在与未来的幽灵造访，被迫直面自己的过往，并踏上一段寻求幸福与救赎的超自然旅程。
gems.summaryEn: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past
gems.whyWatch: 狄更斯经典被赋予暗黑喜剧新解，幽灵夜游兼具救赎与怪谈趣味。
gems.whyWatchEn: A dark-comic rework of Dickens, blending a ghostly night journey, redemption, and eerie fun.
gems.audience: 经典改编、节日奇幻与暗黑喜剧爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of classic adaptations, holiday fantasy, and dark comedy

gems.title: 罪蓝之路
gems.summary: 韩国与日本接连发生带有神秘讯息的残忍凶案，两名刑警联手追查真相，却浑然不觉致命真相不仅近在咫尺，而且暗藏危机。
gems.summaryEn: 韩国与日本接连发生带有神秘讯息的残忍凶案，两名刑警联手追查真相，却浑然不觉致命真相不仅近在咫尺，而且暗藏危机。
gems.whyWatch: 韩日双警追查连环讯息凶案，冷峻谜面下藏着近身杀机。
gems.whyWatchEn: Korean-Japanese detectives chase message-laced murders, with cold puzzles and close-to-home danger.
gems.audience: 硬核犯罪悬疑与跨国刑侦剧迷
gems.audienceEn: Fans of hardboiled crime mysteries and cross-border procedurals

gems.title: 幻视任务
gems.summary: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。
gems.summaryEn: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。
gems.whyWatch: 幻视在AI人格与逃亡之间寻找存在意义，超级英雄壳下是身份寓言。
gems.whyWatchEn: Vision seeks meaning between AI personalities and fugitive life, an identity parable under a superhero shell.
gems.audience: 漫威粉丝、科幻身份议题与角色向剧集爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Marvel fans, sci-fi identity drama, and character-driven series lovers

gems.title: 青春共体
gems.summary: 万圣夜当晚，一场入队仪式沦为人间炼狱，天主教女子舞团因而陷入叛教的罪咎、不洁的欲望与鬼魅的幻影之中。
gems.summaryEn: 万圣夜当晚，一场入队仪式沦为人间炼狱，天主教女子舞团因而陷入叛教的罪咎、不洁的欲望与鬼魅的幻影之中。
gems.whyWatch: 天主教女子舞团的入队夜变灵异修罗场，罪疚与欲望交织成青春噩梦。
gems.whyWatchEn: A Catholic girls' dance troupe initiation turns into an occult ordeal, where guilt and desire become a coming-of-age nightmare.
gems.audience: 宗教恐怖、青春悬疑与女性群像剧爱好者
gems.audienceEn: Fans of religious horror, teen mystery, and female-ensemble drama
